verdict.rationale: Pika documents an API ('Pika API Club: One API for 100+ … video … models') and an MCP server for agents, plus a reachable llms.txt. That makes agent-driven prompt submission plausible from first-party docs. The evidence does not show how an agent would track job status, retrieve the finished asset, or read the per-job credit cost, so the full loop is unproven. Missing for 10: documented job-status/polling or webhook endpoints, asset download/retrieval endpoints, per-request cost or credit reporting via the API, API reference docs, and hands-on corroboration that an agent can complete the loop from docs alone.
